description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Your companion gets two modifications (three at level 15). New options: Bloated (Large, Swipe pushes a Large or smaller target 10 ft, +INT to Death Burst), Gaunt (Speed 45 ft and a Climb Speed; enemies starting their turn within 10 ft make a WIS save or are Frightened until their next turn) and Moist (Swim Speed; attackers within 10 ft that hit it take Acid damage = INT).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Extra modifications chosen on summon (module).
